bases.name: Fire Station 3 – Aldershot rebuild/revitalization
bases.address: 1044 Waterdown Road or Waterdown Road / Plains Road vicinity, Burlington, ON
bases.notes: The Fire Chief’s May 2024 progress memo recommends rebuilding on the existing site or in its vicinity. The 2025–2034 strategic initiatives listing retains revitalization. No 2026 design award, physical start, or final alternative site was found. Existing-base link identifies the affected station, not a confirmed future footprint.

bases.name: Fire Station 4 – replacement / relocation proposal
bases.address: Site / civic address not publicly specified
bases.notes: The strategic capital initiative calls for a South-East relocation and rebuild. The Fire Chief’s 2024 memo instead favours rebuilding on the existing site and questions relocation. The future address and scope remain unresolved; the existing 711 Appleby Line base is not an additional facility.
